name: structured-artifact-viewer
description: Bounded inspection for JSON, JSONL, CSV, TSV, Parquet metadata, and tool artifacts without raw dumps.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect structured artifacts without raw dumps.
interface.longDescription: Provides a compact local CLI and skill guidance for bounded inspection of JSON, JSONL, CSV, TSV, Parquet metadata, and generated tool artifact files. It summarizes shape and previews selected fields without replacing jq or other data-processing tools.
